operations.description: Supply sulfur for thirteen layers at the beginning; add Cd layerwise with four-hour intervals. Charge sulfur sufficient for thirteen monolayers at the start, then add only Cd precursor one monolayer at a time with four-hour intervals. This is a distinct modified SILAR schedule. Turbidity begins at seven layers but remains approximately constant and smaller rather than cycling. QY is low, particles are rods, and XRD gives wurtzite:zinc-blende 40:60. Missing fields: complete initial formulation, exact aliquots.
